scope: CPU source and existing log review; no GPU jobs, production edits, training or checkpoint mutations
objective: Improve causal never-reset active fresh-stream predictive NLL using a persistent graph-constrained predictive readout
source_provenance_limit: Current-disk audit; exact source hashes loaded by the running processes were not recorded at launch.
observed_progress: Observer and physical model receive joint CE and auxiliary gradients.
HX1 throughput is higher and logged peak GPU allocation is lower than HX0.
Same-stage first-pass and matched-context Fresh-B NLL currently favor HX0.

implementation_findings.finding: HX1 feeds delay-attention LayerNorm output with default gain1 directly to decoder, bypassing model.read_norm initialized0.1. Logged read_norm gradient is zero.
implementation_findings.implication: Changed decoder feature scale confounds architecture comparison; initialize and apply the same decoder contract. Its contribution to NLL is a causal hypothesis, not yet isolated.

implementation_findings.finding: 4x4 macro adjacency is hardcoded and all-positive; graph path is not used to derive it. Transition uses A.T times latent H without actual delay queues.
implementation_findings.implication: Attention index k measures latent-network iteration depth, not measured physical ticks. Use actual region/delay-resolved edge aggregates A_d to implement the intended causal observer.

implementation_findings.finding: Regional encoders observe h only; conductance, ALIF, STP and in-flight pulse states are absent.
implementation_findings.implication: Identical h with different hidden physical states can yield different futures. Add already-existing local dynamic states or explicitly model uncertainty over missing states.

implementation_findings.finding: learner carries observer_prior across training windows, but state_dict omits it and predict_fly_next resets to None and discards returned prior per token.
implementation_findings.implication: Unify and serialize observer state across training, inference and resume. Current same-learner active evaluation remains measurable.

implementation_findings.finding: obs_mse is one-step latent innovation between jointly learned encoders/predictor. Fourteen-hop rollouts do not receive timestamp-matched real future state targets. SIGReg constrains final readout only.
implementation_findings.implication: Low MSE does not establish 14-tick physical simulation accuracy or absence of regional collapse. Timestamp-align future observed latent targets and report improvement relative to persistence prediction.

implementation_findings.finding: sigmoid(raw_gain[4,d]) is a learned time/content-independent coordinate gate, initialized0.5; no covariance update.
implementation_findings.implication: Describe it as innovation mixing gain. Mean0.519 does not certify optimal Kalman balance.

revisit_interpretation.claim_supported: Short-gap active revisit savings under continued learning
revisit_interpretation.claim_unestablished: Memory retained across tens of thousands of intervening tokens

competition_hypotheses.mechanism: Decoder scale change makes pretrained logits overconfident
competition_hypotheses.prediction_to_preregister: Holding causal readout and weights fixed, matched-scale decoder must improve same-target loss if excess gain is the immediate cause; joint trained benefit is judged separately.

competition_hypotheses.mechanism: Missing delay/hidden physical states makes the desired transition nonidentifiable from h alone
competition_hypotheses.mathematical_check: Construct two physical states with identical h but different ring or conductance: next physical h can differ. A single deterministic h-only exact predictor cannot represent both.

competition_hypotheses.mechanism: Changing context difficulty and short-gap replay are mistaken for architecture/general memory gains
competition_hypotheses.observed_check: Exact same Fresh-B target intervals reverse the claimed HX1 advantage; logged actual replay gap is256.

review.quantitative_review: Primary CPU exact-target recomputation independently reviewed by /root/hx1_source_review.
review.conclusion_scope: Matching-context whole-system interim comparison supports current HX1 underperformance, without assigning unique cause or rejecting the core predictive-observer direction.

decision: Keep graph predictive observer as a candidate, preserve HX0 baseline, fix decoder/carry-state interface before delay/state/target closure. Register minimal coupled repair and a matched-budget real-stream comparison before any new training.
limits: Snapshot is interim; HX1 has not reached its registered100k budget at audit time.
Architecture changed decoder path, parameter count and graph model together; no unique NLL cause identified.
Active B comparisons are different continually adapting individuals exposed to the same contexts, not a frozen-weight paired ablation.
